description: This Java class implements diagnostics related to security filter chains in a Spring Security context. It logs information about security filter chains, including matchers and contained filters, specifically in the context of the Fineract project.

classes.name: SecurityFilterChainDiagnostics
classes.description: A Spring component that inspects and logs details of security filter chains, primarily for diagnostics purposes.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization callback that logs details of each filter chain after bean properties are set.

methods.name: printFilterChain
methods.description: Determines the type of filter chain and delegates to appropriate printing methods.

methods.name: printDefaultFilterChain
methods.description: Logs the matcher and filters in the default security filter chain.

methods.name: getFormattedFilters
methods.description: Formats the list of filters into a readable string.

methods.name: printUnknownFilterChain
methods.description: Logs the filter chain if its type is unrecognized.
